job: Show the state of a run, a monitor or a key with a dot and a word.
purpose: A dot and a word. Only a running item pulses, and only while it is running (data-live). The icon variant swaps the dot for a status icon that spins while live; the pill variant puts the state in a tinted pill. An fd-status-note after the word adds a short qualifier, muted behind a small dot ("Succeeded · 1 flaky page").
useWhen: A row needs the state of a thing: Running, Passed, Failed, Paused.
A header shows the state of the page object as a tinted pill.
The state needs a two- or three-word qualifier: a count, a time, a region.

avoidWhen.when: A label that is not a state: a plan, a role, a count.
Several jobs with durations in a graph.
Progress of work with a known total.

states.name: live
states.how: data-live; a pulsing ring (or a spinning icon) while the thing runs

variants.useWhen: A status icon replaces the dot; it spins when live.
A tinted pill in a page header.
State: something finished or is healthy.
State: something needs attention soon but is not broken.
State: something failed or is destructive.

parts.role: A short qualifier after the state word: a count, a time or a place.
